title: Homological invariants of edge ideals of the multiple extended complete split-like graphs
summary: We study the graphs $MECS_{b,n}^a \cong \overline{K}_a \join \big(n(K_b+K_2)\big)$, obtained by attaching an independent set of size $a$ to $n$ disjoint copies of the block $K_b+K_2$. For $n=1$, we get $MECS_{b,1}^a$, and recover the results of one-block case studied in [Anand, Gupta, Rather and Singh, Homological invariants of some complete split-like graphs, Beitr. Algebra Geom. (2025)]. Using Hochster's formula, tensor products of minimal free resolutions over disjoint variable sets, and the Betti-number formula for graph joins, we derive explicit descriptions of the independence complex,…
